    <script>
        const MASTER_KEY_SECRETA = "guardia-master-secret-2026";
        const nomesMeses = ["", "Jan", "Fev", "Mar", "Abr", "Mai", "Jun", "Jul", "Ago", "Set", "Out", "Nov", "Dez"];
        let cacheColaboradores = [];

        // --- SISTEMA DE TOASTS ---
        function mostrarToast(mensagem, tipo = 'success') {
            const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast ${tipo}`;
            toast.innerHTML = `<span>${mensagem}</span>`;
            container.appendChild(toast);

            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                toast.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
                toast.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
            }, 3500);
        }

        // --- MÁSCARAS DE ENTRADA (INPUTS) ---
        function aplicarMascaraCNPJ(v) {
            v = v.replace(/\D/g, "");
            v = v.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d)/, "$1.$2");
            v = v.replace(/^(\d{2})\.(\d{3})(\d)/, "$1.$2.$3");
            v = v.replace(/\.(\d{3})(\d)/, ".$1/$2");
            v = v.replace(/(\d{4})(\d)/, "$1-$2");
            return v;
        }

        function aplicarMascaraCPF(v) {
            v = v.replace(/\D/g, "");
            v = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d)/, "$1.$2");
            v = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d)/, "$1.$2");
            v = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,2})$/, "$1-$2");
            return v;
        }

        function aplicarMascaraIP(v) {
            v = v.replace(/[^\d.]/g, "");
            return v;
        }

        document.getElementById('cnpj').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            e.target.value = aplicarMascaraCNPJ(e.target.value);
        });
        document.getElementById('cpf').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            e.target.value = aplicarMascaraCPF(e.target.value);
        });
        document.getElementById('associatedIp').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            e.target.value = aplicarMascaraIP(e.target.value);
        });

        // --- PERSISTÊNCIA DE SESSÃO COM LOCALSTORAGE ---
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const operadorSalvo = localStorage.getItem('guardia_operador');
            if (operadorSalvo) {
                ativarSessao(operadorSalvo);
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('authForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const user = document.getElementById('loginUser').value.trim();
            const pass = document.getElementById('loginPass').value.trim();

            if (!user || !pass) {
                document.getElementById('loginMsg').textContent = 'Preencha o usuário e a senha.';
                return;
            }

            localStorage.setItem('guardia_operador', user);
            ativarSessao(user);
            mostrarToast(`Bem-vindo de volta, ${user}!`, 'success');
        });

        function ativarSessao(user) {
            document.getElementById('loggedUserName').textContent = `Operador: ${user}`;
            document.getElementById('loginOverlay').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('appContainer').style.display = 'block';

            carregarAlvos();
            carregarColaboradores();
        }

        function logout() {
            if (confirm('Deseja encerrar a sessão do operador?')) {
                localStorage.removeItem('guardia_operador');
                document.getElementById('appContainer').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('loginOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
                document.getElementById('loginPass').value = '';
                mostrarToast('Sessão encerrada com segurança.', 'info');
            }
        }

        function mudarSubpagina(nomeSubpagina, btnElement) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.subpage').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));

            document.getElementById(`subpage-${nomeSubpagina}`).classList.add('active');
            btnElement.classList.add('active');
        }

        async function carregarAlvos() {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById('targetsTable');
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/v1/targets');
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error();
                const targets = await response.json();
                
                document.getElementById('kpiTargets').textContent = targets.length;

                if (targets.length === 0) {
                    tableBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">Nenhum alvo cadastrado.</td></tr>`;
                    return;
                }

                tableBody.innerHTML = targets.map(t => `
                    <tr>
                        <td>#${t.id}</td>
                        <td style="word-break: break-all;">${t.targetUrl}</td>
                        <td class="${(t.lastStatus || '').includes('Online') ? 'status-online' : 'status-offline'}">${t.lastStatus || 'Pendente'}</td>
                        <td>${t.lastCheckedAt || 'Nunca'}</td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            } catch (err) {
                tableBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; color: var(--accent-red);">Erro ao carregar alvos.</td></tr>`;
            }
        }

        async function carregarColaboradores() {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById('colaboradoresTable');

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/v1/admin/colaboradores', {
                    headers: { 'X-Admin-Master-Key': MASTER_KEY_SECRETA }
                });

                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Erro ao autenticar com o backend.');

                cacheColaboradores = await response.json();
                renderizarTabelaColaboradores(cacheColaboradores);

                document.getElementById('kpiUsers').textContent = cacheColaboradores.length;
                const uniqueClients = new Set(cacheColaboradores.map(c => c.companyName)).size;
                document.getElementById('kpiClients').textContent = uniqueClients;

            } catch (err) {
                tableBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; color: var(--accent-red);">${err.message}</td></tr>`;
            }
        }

        function renderizarTabelaColaboradores(data) {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById('colaboradoresTable');

            if (data.length === 0) {
                tableBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">Nenhum cadastro encontrado.</td></tr>`;
                return;
            }

            tableBody.innerHTML = data.map(item => {
                const diaNasc = item.birthDay ? String(item.birthDay).padStart(2, '0') : '--';
                const mesNasc = item.birthMonth ? nomesMeses[item.birthMonth] || '--' : '--';
                const anoNasc = item.birthYear || '----';

                return `
                    <tr>
                        <td>
                            <strong>${item.companyName}</strong><br>
                            <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;">CNPJ: ${item.cnpj}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <strong>${item.fullName}</strong><br>
                            <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;">@${item.username} | Nasc: ${diaNasc}/${mesNasc}/${anoNasc}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="badge-role">${item.role}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn-danger" onclick="excluirColaborador(${item.id})">Revogar</button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function filtrarTabela() {
            const termo = document.getElementById('searchFilter').value.toLowerCase();
            const filtrados = cacheColaboradores.filter(c => 
                (c.companyName && c.companyName.toLowerCase().includes(termo)) ||
                (c.fullName && c.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(termo)) ||
                (c.username && c.username.toLowerCase().includes(termo))
            );
            renderizarTabelaColaboradores(filtrados);
        }

        document.getElementById('registerForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const msgEl = document.getElementById('registerMsg');

            const payload = {
                companyName: document.getElementById('companyName').value,
                cnpj: document.getElementById('cnpj').value,
                fullName: document.getElementById('fullName').value,
                username: document.getElementById('username').value,
                password: document.getElementById('password').value,
                confirmPassword: document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value,
                role: document.getElementById('role').value,
                cpf: document.getElementById('cpf').value,
                birthDay: parseInt(document.getElementById('birthDay').value),
                birthMonth: parseInt(document.getElementById('birthMonth').value),
                birthYear: parseInt(document.getElementById('birthYear').value),
                city: document.getElementById('city').value,
                state: document.getElementById('state').value,
                associatedIp: document.getElementById('associatedIp').value || null
            };

            msgEl.style.color = '#f3f4f6';
            msgEl.textContent = 'Gravando ficha cadastral...';

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/v1/admin/register', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Admin-Master-Key': MASTER_KEY_SECRETA
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                const result = await response.json();

                if (response.ok) {
                    msgEl.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    msgEl.textContent = result.mensagem || 'Cadastro realizado com sucesso!';
                    mostrarToast('Ficha cadastral registrada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    document.getElementById('registerForm').reset();
                    carregarColaboradores();
                } else {
                    msgEl.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    msgEl.textContent = result.erro || 'Erro ao cadastrar.';
                    mostrarToast(result.erro || 'Erro ao realizar cadastro.', 'error');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                msgEl.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                msgEl.textContent = 'Erro de conexão com o backend.';
                mostrarToast('Erro de conexão com o backend.', 'error');
            }
        });

        async function excluirColaborador(id) {
            if (!confirm('Deseja realmente revogar esta credencial?')) return;

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/admin/colaboradores/${id}`, {
                    method: 'DELETE',
                    headers: { 'X-Admin-Master-Key': MASTER_KEY_SECRETA }
                });

                if (response.ok) {
                    mostrarToast('Acesso revogado com sucesso.', 'info');
                    carregarColaboradores();
                } else {
                    mostrarToast('Erro ao revogar acesso.', 'error');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                mostrarToast('Erro de conexão.', 'error');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

// Funcao para alternar entre as abas do menu lateral
function switchTab(tabName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tab => tab.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));

    document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');
    event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
}

// Funcao para chamar a rota de varredura de links da API C#
async function executeUrlScan() {
    const urlInput = document.getElementById('scan-url-input').value;
    const resultBox = document.getElementById('scan-result');

    if (!urlInput) {
        alert('Por favor, informe uma URL.');
        return;
    }

    resultBox.classList.remove('hidden');
    resultBox.innerHTML = 'Aguarde... Processando varredura no servidor GuardIA.';

    try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/scanner/url', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ url: urlInput })
        });

        const data = await response.json();
        resultBox.innerHTML = `
            <h4 style="color: #38bdf8; margin-bottom: 8px;">Resultado do Diagnóstico:</h4>
            <p><strong>URL Analisada:</strong> ${data.urlOriginal}</p>
            <p><strong>Status HTTP:</strong> ${data.codigoStatus}</p>
            <p><strong>Redirecionamento:</strong> ${data.possuiRedirecionamento ? 'SIM' : 'NÃO'}</p>
            <p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: bold; color: ${data.possuiRedirecionamento ? '#f43f5e' : '#4ade80'};">
                ${data.avaliacaoRisco}
            </p>
        `;
    } catch (error) {
        resultBox.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #f43f5e;">Erro ao conectar com a API: ${error.message}</span>`;
    }
}
